def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct) if app.activeProduct.classType()=='adsk::fusion::Design' else None
    # find design product
    doc = app.activeDocument
    des = None
    for p in doc.products:
        if p.classType()=='adsk::fusion::Design':
            des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(p)
    body = des.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    holes = {}
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        g = f.geometry
        if g.surfaceType == adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.CylinderSurfaceType:
            ax = g.axis.asArray()
            if abs(abs(ax[1])-1) < 0.01:  # axis along Y
                r = round(g.radius*10, 3)
                bb = f.boundingBox
                ymin, ymax = round(bb.minPoint.y*10,2), round(bb.maxPoint.y*10,2)
                org = g.origin.asArray()
                key = (r, ymin, ymax)
                holes.setdefault(key, []).append((i, round(org[0]*10,2), round(org[2]*10,2)))
    for k in sorted(holes):
        print('r=%.3f y[%.2f..%.2f] n=%d' % (k[0],k[1],k[2],len(holes[k])), holes[k][:8])

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = None
    for p in app.activeDocument.products:
        if p.classType()=='adsk::fusion::Design':
            des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(p)
    body = des.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    import math
    def hole_or_boss(i):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        g = adsk.core.Cylinder.cast(f.geometry)
        pt = f.pointOnFace
        ok, nrm = f.evaluator.getNormalAtPoint(pt)
        o = g.origin.asArray(); ax = g.axis.asArray(); p = pt.asArray()
        v = [p[j]-o[j] for j in range(3)]
        d = sum(v[j]*ax[j] for j in range(3))
        rad = [v[j]-d*ax[j] for j in range(3)]
        L = math.sqrt(sum(c*c for c in rad))
        rad = [c/L for c in rad]
        dot = sum(rad[j]*nrm.asArray()[j] for j in range(3))
        return 'boss' if dot > 0 else 'hole'
    # sample various cylinders
    for i in [80, 101, 91, 160, 31, 33, 29, 23, 49, 37, 60, 62, 9, 11]:
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        g = adsk.core.Cylinder.cast(f.geometry)
        print(i, 'r=', round(g.radius*10,3), hole_or_boss(i))

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, math
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = None
    for p in app.activeDocument.products:
        if p.classType()=='adsk::fusion::Design':
            des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(p)
    body = des.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # cones: list axis, half-angle, y-extent, location to identify drill points vs chamfers
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter()
    samples = {}
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        g = f.geometry
        if g.surfaceType != adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.ConeSurfaceType: continue
        c = adsk.core.Cone.cast(g)
        ax = c.axis.asArray()
        alongY = abs(abs(ax[1])-1) < 0.01
        ha = round(math.degrees(c.halfAngle),1)
        bb = f.boundingBox
        key = (alongY, ha, round((bb.maxPoint.y-bb.minPoint.y)*10,2))
        cnt[key] += 1
        samples.setdefault(key, i)
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        i = samples[k]
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        bb = f.boundingBox
        print(k, 'n=',v, 'ex face', i, 'y[%.2f..%.2f]'%(bb.minPoint.y*10,bb.maxPoint.y*10))
